main_text.l: Paulus Damasco in Arabiam proficiscitur.Gal.
1.pòst redit Damascum. Act. 9. 2. Corint. 11. Gal. 1. ac
triennio post conuersionem venit Hierosoly-
mam ad Petrum. Gal. 1.
Paulus fugiens Iudæos,venit Cæsaream Phœ-
niciæ,inde Tarsum Ciliciæ. Act. 9.
Cornelius conuertitur. Act. 10.
Ecclesia Antiochena plantatur, ibique disci-
puli primùm vocantur Christiani. Act. 11.
Herodes Agrippa ecclesias persequitur, in-
carcerat Petrum, & Iacobum gladio occidit. Act.
12. Paulus & Barnabas peragrat varias provinci-
as, ibique ecclesias fundant. Postea redeunt An-
tiochiam. Act. 13. 14. Quæ omnia collocanda sunt
in an. 45. 46. &seqq. vsque ad an. 50.
Apostoli concilium habent Hierosolymis.
Act. 15. Obseruant docti, quatuor conciliorum men-
tionem fieri in Actis: primi, in quo eligitur Mat-
thias, cap. 1. secundi, in quo diaconi instituuntur,
cap. 6. tertii, in quo Iudaica instituta antiquantur,
c. 15. quartum eliciunt ex historiâc. 21. de Pauli ad-
uentu Hierosolymam.
Paulus cum rescripto apostolico redit Antio-
chiam. Act. 15. Hic est annus 14 ab eâ profectione,
quæ facta est post ipsius conuersionem an. Chri-
sti 37. Gal. 1.
Deinceps in Actis describitur peregrinatio
Pauli. Hic itaque apostoli Pauli itinerarium paucis
trademus. Et primò quidé Paulus Antiochiæ do-
cet: postea secessione Barnabæ factâ & allecto Si-
lâ Syriam & Siciliam peragrat. c. 15. venit Derben
& Lystram: Timotheum sibi adsciscit & circum-
cidit. c. 16. Peragrant Phrygiam, Galatiam, Mysi-
am. Veniunt Troadem. Inde Samothracem,ac
post Neapolim,& Philippos,vbi Lydia conuersa.
ibid. Paulus & Silas per Amphipolim & Apollo-

page.notes: Printed "pòst" and "primùm" carry accents as printed. "historiâc.21." is printed with the accent on â run into "c.21."; reading uncertain. "Chri-sti" is split across lines as printed. The long s and the ligature in "adsciscit" (printed with an f-like form) are read as s. The line numbers at the far left edge of the scan (5, 10, 15 ...) belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. The printed "Gal.1." and "Act.9." carry no space as printed.
